models_evaluated: deep learning tumor segmentation models (contrast-enhanced T1 and T2 MRI)

links.outcome: Preparation and discussion time in simulated multidisciplinary meetings with versus without AI-assisted reports
links.effect: AI reports lengthened neuroradiologist preparation (2 min 54 s vs 2 min 36 s per case) but shortened discussion (1 min 15 s vs 1 min 21 s per case, P < .01).
links.quote: However, the computer-assisted simulated MDTM approach significantly improved (P < .01) MDTM efficiency, with shorter discussion times per patient (1 min 15 s [ ± 0 min and 28 s] per case) compared to standard simulated MDTM (1 min 21 s [ ± 0 min and 44 s] per case).

screen.reason: The study conducts a simulated multidisciplinary team meeting (MDTM) comparing standard care versus an AI-assisted reporting workflow, directly evaluating the impact on clinician preparation time and meeting efficiency.

primary.practice: AI-assisted automated reporting in multidisciplinary team meetings
